mapper.sql: s.qualification_id,s.advertiser_id,s.decision,s.budget_date,s.qualification_token,s.prepared_at,s.state,s.version, s.visible_receipt_id,s.outcome_id AS settled_outcome_id,s.ledger_id,s.closed_at,s.close_reason, q.subject_key AS owner_subject,q.amount,q.issued_at,q.expires_at,l.amount AS captured_amount
FROM ad_conversion_settlement s JOIN ad_conversion_quote q ON q.quote_id=s.qualification_id LEFT JOIN ad_conversion_ledger l ON l.ledger_id=s.ledger_id AND l.qualification_id=s.qualification_id
mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM ad_billing_schema_history WHERE version=13
SELECT quote_id FROM ad_conversion_quote WHERE quote_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT q.quote_id FROM ad_conversion_quote q JOIN ad_conversion_settlement s ON s.qualification_id=q.quote_id WHERE s.state='HELD' AND q.expires_at <= statement_timestamp() ORDER BY q.expires_at,q.quote_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED
SELECT subject_key FROM ad_conversion_quote WHERE quote_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_conversion_visible(receipt_id,qualification_id,subject_key,payload_hash,visible_duration_ms,min_visible_ratio_bps,page_visible) VALUES(#{receiptId},#{qualificationId},#{subject},#{payloadHash},#{visibleDurationMs},#{minVisibleRatioBps},#{pageVisible}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT ,r.receipt_id,r.status,r.canonical_receipt_id,r.accepted_at,r.decided_at,r.payload_hash JOIN ad_conversion_visible r ON r.qualification_id=s.qualification_id WHERE r.receipt_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_conversion_visible SET status=#{status},canonical_receipt_id=#{canonicalReceiptId},accepted_at=#{acceptedAt},decided_at=#{decidedAt} WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_conversion_outcome(outcome_id,advertiser_id,event_id,qualification_id,actor,payload_hash,occurred_at) VALUES(#{outcomeId},#{advertiserId},#{eventId},#{qualificationId},#{actor},#{payloadHash},#{occurredAt}) ON CONFLICT(advertiser_id,event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT ,r.outcome_id AS event_outcome_id,r.event_id,r.occurred_at,r.received_at, r.status,r.canonical_outcome_id,r.decided_at,r.payload_hash JOIN ad_conversion_outcome r ON r.qualification_id=s.qualification_id WHERE r.advertiser_id=#{advertiserId} AND r.event_id=#{eventId}
SELECT outcome_id AS event_outcome_id,advertiser_id,event_id,qualification_id,occurred_at,received_at,status,canonical_outcome_id,decided_at FROM ad_conversion_outcome WHERE outcome_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_conversion_outcome SET status=#{status},canonical_outcome_id=#{canonical},decided_at=#{now} WHERE outcome_id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE ad_conversion_settlement SET visible_receipt_id=#{visible},outcome_id=#{outcome},ledger_id=#{ledger},state=#{state},close_reason=#{reason}, closed_at=#{closedAt},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE qualification_id=#{qualificationId} AND state='HELD' AND version=#{version}
